scope: Public module-level advisory candidates from the first source scan on 1 October 2026. Historical reviews, release images, deployed hosts and other configurations are not comprehensively assessed. No human applicability sign-off is claimed.
notice: Three module-level candidates are retained for review. govulncheck reported zero affected imported packages/called symbols in its tested configuration. That is scoped automated evidence, not a blanket not-affected decision or an independent audit. Embargoed reports stay private.

vulnerabilities.summary: SSH connection deadlock via crafted messages; source scanner flags the containing golang.org/x/crypto module.
vulnerabilities.affected_versions: Upstream advisory affects golang.org/x/crypto/ssh before v0.56.0. The scanned module is v0.55.0; DNS Daddy applicability remains under review.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Evaluate updating the module and rerun all tests. Confirm package/symbol reachability for supported builds before any product affected/not-affected assertion; no dependency update was made by this review.
vulnerabilities.automated_reachability: govulncheck ./... reported 0 affected imported packages and 0 called-symbol vulnerabilities for the tested Linux amd64 configuration; 3 required-module advisories remained.
vulnerabilities.review_date_status: proposed triage date, not an accepted SLA
